title: Psalms 61
paragraphs: ¹ Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer. ² From the ends of the earth I call to you, when my heart grows faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I. ³ For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy. ⁴ Let me dwell in your tent forever; let me take refuge under the shelter of your wings. Selah. ⁵ For you, O God, have heard my vows; you have given me the inheritance of those who fear your name.

⁶ Extend the years of the king's life; may his years span many generations. ⁷ May he be enthroned before God forever; appoint your steadfast love and faithfulness to preserve him. ⁸ Then I will ever sing praises to your name, as I fulfill my vows day after day.
